Two main points of the class
- Bad Lecturer, very poor English and tough to understand. Very boring lectures and lack of hands on learning or help in class, other students would be doing their homework in class and she would never speak up. 
- Easier class structure, no exams and all lab structure.

If you want to learn how to code, skip this class

Dr. Shi's grad level marketing analytics course was amazing! I enjoyed learning from her. She made a known difficult course easy to follow. Her office hours were always open and she really walks through each case step by step and doesn't make you feel dumb for answering questions wrong. Her exams were all open note and everyone made good grades!
